title: System Updates display wrong
author: thawizanator (250346821250056192)
description: when switching the update channel to the stable branch, it doesn't display the correct stable version, its showing the beta branch version
steps:
1.) open app
2.) right click to get to settings
3.) on left panel click on system & logs
4.) click drop down for update channel
5,) cycle through the channels
ai_diagnosis: Report filed for component **System, updates & diagnostics**. Logs have been attached and security-sanitized for maintainer review.
resolution: Updated UpdateCheckWorker.up_to_date to emit both installed version and latest channel release tag; updated settings_ui.py to accurately display latest channel tag on Stable (v2.5.2) and contrast against installed preview build.
